component.name: Darah EDA
component.summary: Plan electronics systems with functional blocks and live design checks

description.p: Darah EDA is a desktop workspace for planning electronics systems before schematic design. Draw functional blocks, connect power and signal interfaces, and trace design decisions to requirements.
Review power budgets and interface compatibility as the design changes. Save projects as readable TOML files and export diagrams, requirements, and reviews for sharing.
Adds AppImage update progress and Flatpak packaging.
